highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 previews Skia m158 alongside HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and more reliable filtered rendering.
highlights_body: The release candidate adds mask-filtered glyph corrections and tighter antialiased image-subset sampling. HarfBuzzSharp adds 30 named Script constants while retaining its existing Script programming model.

bullets.detail: Advances Skia to milestone 158 with unchanged managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moves from the earlier 14.4.0.300 package revision to native HarfBuzz 15.0.0; the revision-only change in Preview 1 did not itself upgrade HarfBuzz.

Adds 30 Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, completing the selected native script list. Existing fields and values, parsing, numeric conversions and horizontal-direction lookup remain intact; no public Font member is removed.

AA and MSAA draws retain logical texture bounds and sampling constraints under minification and strong skew, preventing unrelated backing texels from entering filtered output. Image-filter cache equality now compares the same key bytes as hashing, including signed zero and matrix metadata.

Rasterizes the reloaded glyph's own path, rejects incompatible or sub-byte mask copies with cleared output, and preserves full image-plane strides for clipped embossed glyphs. This avoids stale outlines, buffer overwrites and uncleared mask planes.

bullets.lead: GPU text, hairlines and clip recording
bullets.detail: Reflected zero-length square-capped hairlines keep their device-space size, and text-atlas indices are rounded before sampler selection. Graphite includes pending clip work in render-pass capacity checks and logs and skips draws whose clip stack cannot fit a fresh pass.

Native synchronous Vulkan submission incorporates fence-wait failures, while GRContext.Submit remains void. Displacement offsets use fp32 arithmetic to match filter bounds. A targeted cleanup delay handles device-loss paths on affected ARM proprietary Vulkan drivers from version 42 up to, but not including, 56.

The shared HashCode polyfill uses OS-generated random bytes rather than System.Random for its per-process seed. Hash codes remain stable within a process and randomized between processes; the first use now initializes cryptography support.

contributor_summaries.rolfbjarne: Moved the shared HashCode seed to OS-generated randomness and added analyzer enforcement for shipping code.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduced Skia m158 without changing managed bindings. HarfBuzzSharp moved to package revision 14.4.0.300 while native HarfBuzz remained at 14.4.0.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5: Preview 2 upgraded native HarfBuzz to 15.0.0 and added 30 named Script fields. GPU fixes covered reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection, Graphite clip capacity and affected ARM Vulkan device-loss cleanup.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17: Preview 3 improved displacement-offset precision and native synchronous Vulkan fence-wait reporting, without adding a managed Submit result. The shared HashCode polyfill switched to OS-generated random seeds.
preview_summaries.v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14: Release Candidate 1 corrected mask-filtered glyph rasterization and clipped mask-plane handling. It also tightened antialiased image-subset sampling and made image-filter cache equality consistent with hashing.

harfbuzz_summary: HarfBuzzSharp upgrades the bundled engine to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script fields, including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal. Existing Script behavior and public Font members remain available; the removed hb_font_set_face import was internal.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: Preview 1 introduces the Skia m158 engine with unchanged managed bindings.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: HarfBuzzSharp moves to package revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine remains at 14.4.0.

v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.headline: Preview 2 adds HarfBuzz 15.0.0 and GPU correctness fixes.
v4.158.0-preview.2.26560.5.body: HarfBuzzSharp gains 30 named Script constants. Rendering corrections cover reflected hairlines, text-atlas selection and Graphite clip recording, with a targeted Vulkan device-loss cleanup workaround for affected ARM drivers.

v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.headline: Preview 3 improves displacement-filter precision and native synchronous Vulkan wait handling.
v4.158.0-preview.3.26563.17.body: The shared hash-code polyfill uses OS-generated randomness while remaining stable within a process. Managed API signatures are unchanged.

v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14.headline: Release Candidate 1 improves mask-filtered text and antialiased image-subset rendering.
v4.158.0-rc.1.26567.14.body: Glyph rasterization respects reloaded paths, compatible mask formats and clipped plane strides. Image-filter cache equality now matches its bytewise hash, with no managed API changes.
